traits.name: Web Sense
traits.text: The ogre spider has imprecise tremorsense to detect the vibrations of creatures touching its web.

traits.name: Eerie Flexibility
traits.text: An ogre spider can fit through tight spaces as if it were a Large creature. While Squeezing, it can move at its full speed.

traits.name: Ogre Spider Venom
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison damage (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison damage, clumsy 1, and enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 3 2d6 (2d6) poison damage, clumsy 1, and enfeebled 1 (1 round) Stage 4 2d6 (2d6) poison damage, clumsy 2, and enfeebled 2 (1 round)

traits.name: Web Trap
traits.text: A creature hit by the ogre spider's web attack is immobilized and stuck to the nearest surface until it Escapes (DC 22).

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ bite +15 Damage 2d8+8 (2d8+8) plus ogre spider venom

actions.name: Ranged
actions.text: ⬻ web +13 (range increment 30 feet); Damage web trap
